BiblicalUsage: Justification itself, the acquittal Christ won. He was delivered for our offences and raised again for our justification, and through one righteous act the free gift comes to all men.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe my acquittal was settled at an empty tomb, and because Christ was raised for my justification, I never have to earn the verdict again.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
